what: The site bar on every page of this box's site (the blackbox_agent viewer's <bb-site-nav>, CONTRACT §18; vendored in site/dashboard/ by blackbox_agent's tools/vendor_viewer.py): the box's name (to the landing page) then the open dashboard with ▾ in the top row, its menu listing every dashboard under its group's heading ("layout": "switcher"; "two-rows" spreads the dashboards out as tabs instead), the open dashboard's own tabs below. A box adds its own domain dashboard (a page another repo builds, dropped into site/) with one entry in dashboards and its id in order, and that page includes the bar (README.md, 'Add a dashboard'). Every href is relative to this file.
